trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Pure-data table; ten trap categories n/a. FULLY RECOMPUTED, all seven rows. B_obs is correct against AME2020 in every row (2.22457, 28.29567, 39.2446, 92.1618, 127.6193, 342.052 round to the printed values). The 'Mass error' column reproduces EXACTLY as (B_obs - B_pred)/M_atom with M_atom = Z m_p + N m_n - B_obs: computed -0.144, +0.2385, -0.04591, +0.08295, +0.07049, +0.06629 against printed -0.144, +0.238, -0.046, +0.083, +0.070, +0.066. The table is internally consistent. HEADLINE FLAG for the report: that column makes a badly-missing binding prediction look like a sub-0.25 pct success. The BINDING errors (B_pred - B_obs)/B_obs are +121.6 pct for 2D, -31.4 pct for 4He, +7.6 pct for 7Li, -10.1 pct for 12C, -8.2 pct for 16O and -7.2 pct for 40Ca - the small percentages come entirely from dividing by a mass dominated by Z m_p + N m_n, which is the calibration, not the prediction. Reporting the mass error rather than the binding error is the double-counting the 2026-08-11 absolute-mass excision exists to remove. SECONDARY FLAGS: no q_0 pin, no witness path and no producer are recorded anywhere in the block.
